sections.heading: Research context
sections.text: This narrative review considers how embryonic stem cells can be directed toward retinal pigment epithelial cells. It organizes published culture approaches; it does not report a new patient cohort, clinical trial, or head-to-head experiment by the review authors.
sections.source_locator: PDF p. 1 / journal p. 2079: 文献综述, 摘要, Abstract and Introduction

sections.heading: Culture approaches
sections.text: The review discusses cytokine induction, two- and three-dimensional differentiation, coculture, and scaffold encapsulation. Its scaffold discussion covers alginate, fibrin, and polyethylene-glycol/gellan systems. Individual experimental outcomes are attributed to the studies cited in these sections.
sections.source_locator: PDF pp. 2–3 / journal pp. 2080–2081: §§1, 2, 3, 4.1–4.3; References

sections.heading: Evidence boundary
sections.text: The outlook weighs differentiation efficiency, time, cost, function, immune rejection, and ethical concerns. It identifies long-term safety and effectiveness after transplantation as unresolved; this review does not establish a clinically validated replacement therapy.

sections.heading: Authorship boundary
sections.text: The first Chinese author is 张格 and the last is 张戈. Both are printed as Ge Zhang in English. Han Zhu is the named corresponding author. The article supplies no ORCID or individual identifier that uniquely connects either Ge Zhang entry with this site researcher.
